notes: Snipe-IT has no default login: the first visitor runs the setup wizard (/setup), which checks the environment, creates the database tables and then asks for the site name and the first administrator. Open the site and finish it immediately after install.

Environment values follow the official .env.docker at v8.8.0, with the panel's own: APP_URL is the site's HTTPS address, APP_KEY is base64 of 32 generated bytes, and APP_TRUSTED_PROXIES lists the private ranges Docker uses for the panel's proxy, so links and redirects stay on HTTPS. SECURE_COOKIES is on because the site is HTTPS only.

Mail goes to the application log (MAIL_MAILER=log) until you configure SMTP: set MAIL_MAILER=smtp and the MAIL_* variables in the panel's environment editor. Password resets and checkout emails are not delivered before that.

MariaDB 11.4 (the official compose file pins 11.4.7; this uses the newer 11.4.13 patch release of the same series) runs as the second service with its own volume and no published port. The image's start script runs the migrations on every start.
Uploads, generated keys and backups live in the data volume (/var/lib/snipeit), the volume of the official compose file.
